lines.beaver_en: Hello. What kind of consultation would you like today?
lines.learner: 돈 관리 습관에 대해 상담받고 싶어요.
lines.en: I'd like advice about my money habits.
lines.roman: don gwalli seupgwane daehae sangdambatgo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. How do you manage your salary?
lines.en: When my salary is deposited, I save first.

lines.beaver_en: You're doing well. Do you have any loans?
lines.learner: 네, 작년에 집 때문에 대출을 받았어요.
lines.en: Yes, I took out a loan for a house last year.
lines.roman: ne, jangnyeone jip ttaemune daechureul badasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Have you ever been late on interest?
lines.learner: 한 번도 연체한 적 없어요. 꼭 제때 내요.
lines.en: Never been overdue. I always pay on time.
lines.roman: han beondo yeonchehan jeok eopseoyo. kkok jettae naeyo.

lines.en: Last month I paid for a laptop in one lump sum.

lines.beaver_en: Did you also compare card benefits?
lines.learner: 네, 카드에 따라 수수료가 달라서 비교했어요.
lines.en: Yes, fees differ by card, so I compared them.
lines.roman: ne, kadeue ttara susuryoga dallaseo bigyohaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How do you prepare for taxes?
lines.learner: 세금 낼 액수를 미리 계산해서 모아 둬요.
lines.en: I calculate the tax amount ahead and save it.
lines.roman: segeum nael aeksureul miri gyesanhaeseo moa dwoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you often use cash, by any chance?
lines.en: I only carry a few bills in my wallet.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have any goals for the future?
lines.learner: 재산을 모아서 여유 있게 살고 싶어요.
lines.en: I want to build wealth and live comfortably.
lines.roman: jaesaneul moaseo yeoyu itge salgo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 다음에 연금 상담도 해 드릴게요.
lines.beaver_en: Then I'll help you with pensions next time.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom daeume yeongeum sangdamdo hae deurilgeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 연금 지급 날짜도 알려 주세요. 감사합니다.
lines.en: Okay, please tell me the payment dates too. Thank you.
lines.roman: ne, yeongeum jigeup naljjado allyeo juseyo. gamsahamnida.
